worldcombat.skill.bellydrum.summary: Beats its belly to cut its own health down to a floor in exchange for maximum Attack. The power lasts for a visible window, after which those stages are taken back (or are taken back early if the window is removed). It cannot be used at or below that floor.
worldcombat.skill.bellydrum.use.1: Max out Attack before a fight
worldcombat.skill.bellydrum.use.2: Force a decision with a visible power window
Drumming keeps %1$s of maximum health and raises Attack by %2$s stage(s); it cannot be used at or below that floor.

The power lasts %1$s, keeping the raised Attack stages throughout and taking them all back at the end (or if the window is removed early); drumming takes %2$s to prepare and %3$s to recover, and an interrupted wind-up costs no PP.
worldcombat.skill.bellydrum.stance.endur: Enduring drum: keeps only 40 percent of health for a longer power window, built for a war of attrition.
worldcombat.skill.bellydrum.stance.frenz: Frenzied drum: keeps half the health for a shorter window, a lighter price paid over a tighter window.
worldcombat.skill.bellydrum.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s; cooldown %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bellydrum.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bellydrum.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bellydrum.preference.e: On: keeps 40 percent of health and stretches the power to 24 s. Off: keeps half the health and holds the power for 10 s. The first is riskier and longer, the second cheaper.
worldcombat.skill.bellydrum.preference.a: The companion drums only above this health ratio; lower dares to spend half a life, higher reinforces near full health.
